g.text: Hook and event flow
A Claude Code session reports back by running `conveyor hook <Event>` with a JSON payload on stdin.
Every hook: map cwd under ~/.conveyor/workspaces/<KEY> to a task key (anything else is ignored). Always exit 0; errors go to logs/hook.log.
Claude Code fires
internal/hook does
Result in the database
UserPromptSubmit
resolveRun: match the session id, else adopt a
launching run with no session, else create a
kind=interactive run. Run becomes running.
Task needs_you becomes running, if this is the
latest run (you replied in the terminal).
Notification
Record what Claude is waiting on.
events row, kind=notification (shown on the task).
Stop
Parse the <conveyor> block in last_assistant_message.
Sum tokens and context peak from the transcript.
Run becomes finished with summary, state, next,
criteria.
Auto run only: agent comment, one proposed learning
per `learning:` line, child tasks per `spawn:` line.
Then, only if the task is running:
pending comments: todo | status done: review
status failed: todo (failed at the limit)
no block: needs_you
PreToolUse (Bash)
Launched sessions only. Look at gh pr comment, gh pr
review, gh issue comment and gh api .../comments.
The body must start with pr_comment_prefix.
Missing prefix: answer on stdout with permissionDecision
deny, so the command never runs. Default prefix:
"ai agent: ". Bodies built by the shell are allowed.
Where the hooks are registered
<home>/claude-settings.json, passed as --settings on every launch
All four events. Written by claude.WriteSettings, with
worktree.bgIsolation: none. Covers runs the dispatcher starts.
~/.claude/settings.json, edited by `conveyor hooks install`
UserPromptSubmit, Stop, Notification only. PreToolUse is left out
on purpose: it would apply the PR prefix to every Claude session.
Sessions you start by hand in a task worktree show up as interactive runs.
